videos.script: Most of a production prompt never changes. The same long guide goes out with every message, and the model reads it every time. {{guide}} A prompt cache lets the model skip reading what it has read before. It does not store answers. It stores the work of reading the start of a prompt. {{cache}} The catch is the word start. A cache matches from the first token. The first token that differs ends the match, and everything after it is read again. {{blocks}} So you time the same prompt in two orders. Guide first, and the first call reads for five seconds, every call after it for under one. {{static}} Message first, and no two calls share more than a tag. Every call reads for four and a half seconds, and the median call takes twice as long. {{first}} Then you check what the cache must not move. The order changed the answers too: five messages broke, and none were fixed. {{compare}}
